workload: Exactly the first 46 prefill tokens of the saved real SmolLM2-135M story run; persistent KV state, all transformer layers and vocabulary logits
method: One complete replay per compiler, previous reusable first, then heartbeat; cold timing caches, one compilation per replay; historical recorded RTL baseline, not rerun; no concurrent RTL job

scope_definitions.lpn_core_seconds: Compiled event-driven simulation between begin and complete; excludes functional execution, metadata preparation, compilation and process startup
scope_definitions.single_use_lpn_seconds: Functional ISA execution + timing metadata preparation + compilation/cache + native process; matches prior reported 313-second scope
scope_definitions.session_seconds: Complete replay including imports, checkpoint fingerprint verification, model/image initialization, all step work, input serialization/hash checking and progress reports; not RTL execution
